inputs.value:
set -exu

REQUEST_BODY='{
  "projectId": "300057",
  "pipelineId": "'"${PIPELINE_ID}"'",
  "pipelineRunId": "'"${PIPELINE_RUN_ID}"'"
}'

# 使用 curl 发送请求，-s 表示静默，-f 表示失败返回非零，-w 输出状态码
RESPONSE=$(curl -s -f -w "\n%{http_code}" \
  -X POST 'https://apig.openlibing.com:443/openlibing-cicd/project/pipeline/external/record' \
  -H "X-Apig-AppCode: $APP_CODE" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d "$REQUEST_BODY")

# 获取 HTTP 状态码（最后两行是状态码）
HTTP_STATUS=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | tail -n1)
RESPONSE_BODY=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | head -n -1)

# 打印返回结果（含状态码和响应体）
echo "✅ HTTP 状态码: $HTTP_STATUS"
echo "💬 响应内容："
echo "$RESPONSE_BODY"
